category_title: Students who use physical presence and threats to intimidate faculty
minimal_context: The student has stayed behind after an evening class to wait for the professor to be alone.
dialogue:
TUTOR: I see you stayed behind until all of the other students had left. What did you want to discuss?

STUDENT: (Just stands there with his legs spread apart, staring at you.)

TUTOR: Do you have a question about the evening class?

STUDENT: (Moves closer and closer, invading your personal space.)

TUTOR: I need to get going now.

STUDENT: (Continues moving closer, leaving you cornered and backed up against the wall with no immediate outlet.)

options.A: Establish consistent routines during the evening class sessions and make believe that the student is a part of that cycle.
options.B: Provide a clear beginning and end for each task or discussion during the evening class sessions and subsequent interactions.
options.C: Invite peers into the classroom or office to observe the behavior and offer advice or guidance related to handling the student bully.
options.D: Guide the student through a healing-lake visualization, encouraging him to observe the lake carefully and notice that it is always changing, yet always itself.
